{{Quote|Interesting. There are at least three styles of architecture out there&mdash;human plus two different alien species. It's not often you see such diversity in the same planetary region, let alone side by side in the same city. In fact, that palace thing in front of us has itself incorporated elements from all three styles.|Grand Admiral Thrawn|<ref name="HTTE" />}}
The '''great palace'''<ref name="HTTES">''[[Heir to the Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref> was located in a [[Mount Tantiss city|city]]<ref name="HTTE" /> southwest of [[Mount Tantiss/Legends|Mount Tantiss]]<ref name="Wayland">{{DB|location|wayland|Wayland}}</ref> on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Wayland/Legends|Wayland]]. After the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Joruus C'baoth]] [[Death/Legends|killed]] the [[Guardian of Mount Tantiss]], the people of Wayland built a crypt for his body in the palace. It became surrounded by candles, one for every person who came to visit him after his death, all of whom (except [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]], [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]], and [[Rukh/Legends|Rukh]]) were subsequently killed by C'baoth.<ref name="HTTE" />
